items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And she had a sister called Honey...Honey...Honey Somethin'... Sweet Pea Spivey.

ctx.x: called "Mean Black Snake Blues." "Mean black snake's been sucking my (?) down." And that was a terrific hit, and that just threw her up to the top. But she didn't follow up. And she had a sister called Honey...Honey...Honey Somethin'... Sweet Pea Spivey.
